outfit.name: 放学后辣妹微敞校服与绝对领域
outfit.prose: Her unbuttoned navy school blazer draped casually, worn over a loose white collared shirt with the top three buttons undone to reveal a peek of a black lace bandeau beneath, paired with a loosely knotted striped tie. A micro pleated navy skirt sits high above sheer black thighhighs, which are held up by a buckled leather thigh band that creates a noticeable soft skin pinch.
